name: Työkkäri
description: The employment office keeps a desk in the 1990s kylätalo. Take a queue number. The youth club meets downstairs.
greeting: The coffee machine is broken again.
Teenagers are playing table hockey downstairs.

hello: Have a seat. The form is only twelve pages.
Did you fill in your job-seeker report?
hired: Congratulations! I'll mark you as employed.
Well done! One less form for me.
rejected: They chose someone else. Don't lose heart.
No luck this time. There's a course for that, you know.
counselling: Here's a little tip for you.
quit: Are you sure? Fine, I'll update the form.
work: Good day's work. Only forty forms left.
broke: The application is free. The rest isn't.
refuse: The system won't let me, I'm afraid.
